info.name: Shining School - Question Paper Generator API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman API Collection for Section-Based Question Paper Generator Module in Shining School ERP.

### Key Features:
- Section-based hierarchy: **Paper → Sections/Headings → Questions**
- All 7 Supported Question Types:
  1. `mcq` (Multiple Choice Questions with A, B, C, D options)
  2. `fill_blank` (Fill in the blanks with `______`)
  3. `true_false` (True & False with `(        )`)
  4. `matching` (Matching columns with dynamic pairs)
  5. `one_word` (Answer in One Word or Sentence with `Answer: ______________________`)
  6. `image_question` (Image Questions with uploaded diagram/figure)
  7. `other` (Descriptive / open-ended questions)
- Custom display class (`paper_class_name` e.g. "XI – A")
- Flexible non-decimal & decimal marks (`1`, `0.5`, `1.5`, `2`, `5`, `10`)
- Role-based visibility and teacher attribution (`create_by` / `user_id`)
- PDF and Word (DOC) exports

request.description: Authenticate user credentials and retrieve a Bearer access token.
Fetches active classes, subjects, paper settings (default instructions & watermark), active teachers, and supported 7 question types.

item.name: Create Section-Based Question Paper (All 7 Question Types)

request.description: Creates a section-based question paper with arbitrary section headings, sub-instructions, flexible marks, custom display class name (`paper_class_name`), and all 7 supported question types without requiring correct answer selection.
Retrieves list of question papers. Admin users see all papers; teachers see only their own papers.
Retrieves complete hierarchical data of a question paper including sections, questions, and matching/MCQ options.
Updates paper details and replaces section/question hierarchy transactionally.
Changes the status of a question paper from 'draft' to 'published'.
Clones an existing question paper with all its sections and questions as a new draft copy.
Soft-deletes a question paper by setting deleted_at timestamp.
Streams clean printable HTML view formatted for direct printing to PDF with watermark, signatures, section headings, and Date line.
Streams Microsoft Word compatible (.doc) file download of the section-based question paper.
